query:
SELECT id, latin_name, common_name, family 
FROM plants 
WHERE latin_name LIKE '%,%' 
   OR latin_name LIKE '%"%' 
   OR latin_name LIKE '%;%'
   OR latin_name LIKE '%|%'
   OR latin_name LIKE '%\t%'
   OR latin_name REGEXP '^[0-9]'
   OR LENGTH(latin_name) > 100
ORDER BY LENGTH(latin_name) DESC
LIMIT 50;
